Descrizione Strategy& is the global strategy consultancy of PwC. In Switzerland, we mainly support leading Swiss companies in shaping their international presence – from the strategy at the headquarters to the transformation of global business areas. We develop tailor-made strategies for leading companies based on clearly differentiating competitive advantages. Our team is characterized by particularly close cohesion: from office events to exciting locations via regular team dinner and team building events – the fun at work is not too short. ## Mansioni - As a manager:in the Strategy & Transformation Team you work with leading national and international organizations from different industries. - Together with your team, you develop strategies and concepts along the entire value chain – from business and operating models to technology and digital strategies to transformation programs. - You conduct (partial) projects, control interdisciplinary teams and act as an interface between customers, partners: inside and internal stakeholders. - You work closely with colleagues from different consulting areas and use the expertise of our global network to develop and implement holistic solutions. - In addition, you take a mentor: in-house, promote the development of your colleagues and actively contribute to an open, collaborative team culture. - Through training you continuously deepen your method, leadership and industry skills. - In projects, you analyze complex questions of our customers: inside, structuring problems and developing strategic solutions with sustainable added value. - Typical topics are: - Development of corporate, business and digital strategies - Redesign of business and operating models - Planning and implementation of transformation and change programs - Support for M&A initiatives, carve-outs and portfolio strategies - Optimization of organizations, processes and value chains - Use of data, analytics and new technologies for decision support - You are responsible for budget results for your projects and ensure quality. - In addition, you actively support the acquisition of new projects, develop offers and expand existing customer relationships. ##
• Requisiti - Academic background: above-average university degree (Master, MBA or PhD) in economics, (economic) informatics, (economic)engineering, natural sciences or social sciences, statistics/data science or a comparable subject area. - Professional experience: Multiannual experience in a top strategy consulting or in responsible corporate functions, ideally focusing on strategy, transformation, digitization or performance improvement. jobs.title: Director in Quality & Regulatory Management - Advisory Services
jobs.description:
• Sell, lead and, together with the team, deliver high-impact projects engaging with senior stakeholders from high-profile clients. You will actively drive business development by originating opportunities, leading proposals and converting them into successful client engagements.

• Develop new ideas and propositions to share with clients to secure new and expand existing projects. The projects typically include: (i) Quality and QMS strategy, operating model and target‑state design, (ii) Regulatory strategy and operating model design (e.g. for submissions, registrations, labelling, post‑market / lifecycle management), (iii) Design and implementation of new technologies and ways of working, (iv) Digital strategies and functional roadmaps

• Cover Quality and Regulatory functional expertise across the value chain. You will also work closely with our consulting teams covering commercial, market access, supply chain and other functions.

• Drive the growth and transformation of our Quality and Regulatory team, capabilities and consulting business. You will work closely with PwC's global network of experts and our enterprise AI team to develop and scale new, AI‑enabled propositions, delivery models and assets – both for our clients and for how we operate at PwC.

• Actively build and expand your own network and represent PwC at client meetings, industry events and conferences.

• Work in a fast-growing environment, which is driven by respect, collegiality, and strong team spirit (winning as team, not as an individual).

• You have more than 10 years' experience working within Quality and/or Regulatory, of which at least 6 years in consulting.

• In consulting, you will have worked or are working in a management consulting firm, advising clients on Quality and Regulatory strategy, and you have experience in running large transformation projects and developing new propositions and work.

• In industry roles, you have been exposed to many of the key steps of improving business functions that operate along the value chain.

• As an experienced hire, you have a solid track record in both business development and project delivery: you originate and shape opportunities, lead proposal processes and successfully convert them into client engagements. You leverage a strong personal industry network with decision-makers along the value chain and are passionate about networking and building long-term client relationships.

• You have exposure to some of the following areas: GxP and other relevant regulatory frameworks, data privacy/protection, digital strategy development, operating model design, system design/improvement/maintenance, process improvement, technology implementation and digital and analytics technologies, including AI and practical use cases in Quality and Regulatory functions.

jobs.title: Audit Senior Associate / Assistant Manager - Trade, Industries & Services / US GAAP
jobs.description:
In our Audit - Trade, Industries & Services (TIS) practice, we don't just analyze numbers; we uncover insights that help businesses grow, adapt, and succeed in a rapidly changing world. We work with a diverse range of clients, from global corporations to dynamic local businesses, helping them navigate through challenges, seize opportunities, and build a sustainable future.

By combining our unique perspectives and leveraging advanced technology, we're shaping the future of auditing and the industries we serve. Every project is an opportunity to grow, make an impact, and contribute to building trust in society.

• Take ownership of planning, executing, and completing group and local audits across a variety of non-financial services industries, with a focus on US GAAP and SOX testing.

• Perform SOX internal controls testing in compliance with the latest PCAOB guidance, demonstrating your expertise in internal controls for US-listed groups as well as their significant subsidiaries based in Switzerland.

• Collaborate with international teams and clients, fostering strong relationships and ensuring seamless communication across borders.

• Drive the integration of our remote team members, ensuring they are part of our local engagement team.

• Leverage digital tools, data analysis software, and automation solutions to structure, visualize, and present actionable insights that add value for clients.

• Embrace new challenges and opportunities to grow, developing your leadership skills and contributing to the success of your team and clients.

• A university degree in accounting or a related field, with a US CPA (or a comparable certification) completed or in progress.

• 3-5 years of recent experience in a public accounting firm, with solid expertise in US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, PCAOB, and SOX.

• Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and develop tailored solutions for clients.

• Proficiency in English; knowledge of German, French, or Italian is an advantage.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with international teams, foster client relationships, and manage expectations.

Why Join Us?
We understand that your career is more than just a job - it's a journey. That's why we're committed to supporting you every step of the way:

• Professional Growth: Access tailored learning opportunities, mentorship, and financial support for further certifications.

descriptionByLocale.it: Nella nostra practice Audit - Trade, Industries & Services (TIS), non ci limitiamo ad analizzare i numeri; scopriamo intuizioni che aiutano le aziende a crescere, adattarsi e avere successo in un mondo in rapida evoluzione. Lavoriamo con una vasta gamma di clienti, da grandi corporation globali a dinamiche imprese locali, aiutandoli ad affrontare le sfide, cogliere le opportunità e costruire un futuro sostenibile. Combinando le nostre prospettive uniche e sfruttando la tecnologia avanzata, stiamo plasmando il futuro dell'audit e dei settori che serviamo. Ogni progetto è un'opportunità per crescere, fare la differenza e contribuire a costruire fiducia nella società. Assumersi la responsabilità della pianificazione, dell'esecuzione e del completamento degli audit di gruppo e locali in una varietà di settori di servizi non finanziari, con un focus su US GAAP e test SOX. Eseguire il testing dei controlli interni SOX in conformità con le ultime linee guida PCAOB, dimostrando la propria competenza nei controlli interni per i gruppi quotati negli USA e per le loro filiali significative con sede in Svizzera. Collaborare con team internazionali e clienti, favorendo solide relazioni e garantendo una comunicazione fluida oltre confine. Promuovere l'integrazione dei membri remoti del team, assicurandosi che facciano parte del team di incarico locale. Sfruttare strumenti digitali, software di analisi dei dati e soluzioni di automazione per strutturare, visualizzare e presentare informazioni operative che aggiungano valore per i clienti. Abbracciare nuove sfide e opportunità di crescita, sviluppando le proprie capacità di leadership e contribuendo al successo del team e dei clienti. Laurea universitaria in contabilità o in un campo correlato, con US CPA (o certificazione comparabile) completata o in corso. 3-5 anni di recente esperienza in uno studio di contabilità pubblica, con solida competenza in US GAAP, US GAAS, IFRS, PCAOB e SOX. Solide capacità analitiche e di pensiero critico, con la capacità di interpretare dati finanziari complessi e sviluppare soluzioni su misura per i clienti. Padronanza dell'inglese; la conoscenza del tedesco, del francese o dell'italiano è un vantaggio. Eccellenti capacità comunicative e interpersonali, con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente con team internazionali, coltivare le relazioni con i clienti e gestire le aspettative. Perché unirsi a noi? Sappiamo che la tua carriera è molto più di un semplice lavoro — è un percorso. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a supportarti in ogni passo del cammino: Crescita professionale: accesso a opportunità di apprendimento personalizzate, mentoring e supporto finanziario per ulteriori certificazioni. Flessibilità: modalità di lavoro che ti aiutano a bilanciare vita professionale e personale. Cultura inclusiva: un ambiente diversificato e collaborativo dove la tua prospettiva unica è valorizzata. Strumenti innovativi: sfrutta la tecnologia avanzata e approcci creativi per ridefinire il futuro dell'audit. Lavoro orientato allo scopo: contribuisci a progetti significativi che fanno la differenza per i nostri clienti, la società e il pianeta. Pronto/a a fare la differenza? Unisciti alla nostra community of solvers e aiutaci a plasmare il futuro dell'audit - digitale, sostenibile e globale. Candidati ora!

jobs.title: Senior Associate / Manager Financial Services Consulting - Liquidity & Funding
jobs.description:
• Join PwC Advisory to become part of our Strategy & Transformation Banking Team in Zurich.

• Be part of our L&F Team and help our banking clients to transform their liquidity and funding practices to improve their opportunity cost efficiency and to fulfil internal and external requirements, while closely collaborating with Finance, Banking Restructuring and Risk Teams.

• BE responsible to further develop the go-to-market strategy for liquidity and funding and manage projects with our key banking clients.

• Developi solutions that will help our clients to efficiently measure, manage and use their liquid assets on a short-term operational and mid-term structural basis and integrate that view into their risk understanding in a rising interest rate environment.

• Continuously further develop the service offering for the liquidity and funding practice and provide thought leadership to the banking sector.

• Be part of a team that operates strongly in an interdisciplinary environment within PwC. You will be using and building bridges to our fellow teams that work at the technological edge in big data analysis and artificial intelligence.

• Work in a global environment with the largest banks, you will be embedded in a network of our company that gathers and shares industry insights in Liquidity & Funding worldwide.

• An excellent University / ETH Master's degree in Banking, Finance, Economics, Business Administration or an adjacent field that enables you to work with banks and other financial service companies.

• A strong affinity for numbers and logical processes, are excellent with Excel and other quantitative programs and feel highly comfortable showing your ideas in Power Point.

• Take responsibility for constantly increasing your knowledge in Banking on a personal, intrinsic basis throughout your career.

• More than 3 years (SA) / 5 years (M) of hands-on experience in the Banking Sector or Consulting and have gathered extensive experience working on liquidity and funding topics incl. Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP) and working with Trading, Treasury Departments, Financial Risk or Finance and Accounting Departments.

• Extensive experience with complex banking products.

• Fluent in English. German is a highly significant plus and other languages (e.g. French) are welcome.

• Willing to travel to our client's international locations if required but are not disappointed if you are not needed to leave Zurich at all for a given time.

• Programming skills are highly recommended and beneficial (e.g. python).

• CFA, FRM certificates are a significant plus.

descriptionByLocale.it: Entra in PwC Advisory per far parte del nostro team Strategy & Transformation Banking a Zurigo. Fai parte del nostro team L&F e aiuta i nostri clienti bancari a trasformare le loro pratiche di liquidità e funding per migliorare l'efficienza dei costi opportunità e soddisfare i requisiti interni ed esterni, collaborando strettamente con i team Finance, Banking Restructuring e Risk. Sii responsabile dell'ulteriore sviluppo della go-to-market strategy per la liquidità e il funding e della gestione di progetti con i nostri principali clienti bancari. Sviluppa soluzioni che aiutino i clienti a misurare, gestire e utilizzare efficacemente le loro attività liquide su base operativa a breve termine e strutturale a medio termine, integrando questa visione nella loro comprensione del rischio in un contesto di tassi d'interesse in aumento. Developpa continuamente l'offerta di servizi per la practice liquidità e funding e fornisci thought leadership al settore bancario. Fai parte di un team che opera in un ambiente fortemente interdisciplinare all'interno di PwC. Utilizzerai e costruirai ponti con i team colleghi che lavorano all'avanguardia tecnologica nell'analisi dei big data e nell'intelligenza artificiale. Lavora in un contesto globale con le maggiori banche; sarai inserito in una rete della nostra azienda che raccoglie e condivide le conoscenze di settore in materia di Liquidity & Funding in tutto il mondo. • Requisiti: Eccellente laurea magistrale universitaria / ETH in Banking, Finance, Economics, Business Administration o in un campo affine che ti permetta di lavorare con banche e altre società di servizi finanziari. Forte affinità con i numeri e i processi logici, eccellenti capacità in Excel e altri programmi quantitativi, e grande facilità nel presentare le tue idee in Power Point. Assumi la responsabilità di accrescere continuamente le tue conoscenze nel settore bancario su base personale e intrinseca nel corso della tua carriera. Oltre 3 anni (SA) / 5 anni (M) di esperienza pratica nel settore bancario o nella consulenza, con un'ampia esperienza nei temi di liquidità e funding, inclusi Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), e nel lavoro con reparti Trading, Treasury, Financial Risk o Finance e Accounting. Ampia esperienza con prodotti bancari complessi. Inglese fluente. Il tedesco è un plus molto significativo; altre lingue (es. francese) sono benvenute. Disponibilità a viaggiare presso le sedi internazionali dei clienti, se necessario, ma senza delusioni qualora non fosse necessario lasciare Zurigo per un determinato periodo. Le competenze di programmazione sono altamente raccomandate e vantaggiose (es. Python). I certificati CFA e FRM costituiscono un plus significativo.

jobs.title: Manager – U.S. Tax (Private Clients)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled U.S. Tax Manager to lead and manage complex tax engagements for our private clients. In this role, you will leverage your comprehensive understanding of U.S. tax regulations and financial planning to provide strategic tax planning and compliance services tailored to high-net-worth individuals. Your ability to interpret complex tax data will be essential in navigating the ever-evolving tax landscape for our clients.

In this role, you will:

• Build and maintain strong relationships with private clients, understanding their unique financial needs and delivering tailored tax solutions.

• Develop and implement tax planning strategies that align with client objectives and industry standards, maximizing tax efficiencies for high-net-worth individuals.

• Oversee the preparation and review of complex tax returns, ensuring compliance with U.S. tax regulations and internal standards.

• Provide expert guidance on complex tax issues, leveraging your in-depth knowledge of U.S. tax regulations and their application to private client scenarios.

• Interpret and analyze tax data to generate insightful reports and recommendations, assisting clients in making informed financial decisions.

• A minimum of 5 years of U.S. taxation experience with an international accounting firm or similar, specializing in U.S. compliance and consulting tax issues for high-net-worth individuals.

• A bachelor's degree with a specialization in accounting/taxation or a law degree from an accredited university.

• CPA or IRS Enrolled Agent qualification.

• Extensive technical skills relevant to private clients, coupled with a successful track record in identifying client needs and pursuing new service opportunities.

• Proven leadership experience, including establishing direction, motivating team members, and fostering innovation.

• Demonstrated success in generating new business, writing proposals, and collaborating across engagements and business units.

• Advanced knowledge of tax compliance software and proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siete parte di una squadra che non solo controlla i numeri, ma riconosce le connessioni. A PwC nel campo dell'audit - servizi finanziari (banking), si analizzano le aziende: Quanto hanno successo? Quali sono le opportunità e i rischi? Come possono diventare più sostenibili?

Qui si lavora con persone curiosi e ambiziose per plasmare l'economia di domani – digitalmente, in modo sostenibile e globale. Ogni progetto è unico e vi offre la possibilità di crescere e fare la differenza.

La diversità è la nostra forza. La tua prospettiva conta e ti sosteniamo nel raggiungere i tuoi obiettivi.

Non vuoi solo un lavoro, vuoi fare la differenza? Benvenuti a PwC! Qui puoi:
• Comprendere e trasformare le aziende: rivedere i bilanci consolidati e annuali e garantire che soddisfino i requisiti normativi – in loco, in ufficio o in modo flessibile dall'ufficio di casa.

• Definire il futuro digitalmente: utilizzare strumenti all'avanguardia, AI e analisi dei dati per prendere l'auditing a un nuovo livello. Le tue idee valgono!

• Promuovere la sostenibilità: sostenere la revisione dei rapporti ESG e accompagnare le aziende verso una maggiore consapevolezza ambientale e responsabilità sociale.

• Costruisci reti: Collabora con team di leadership e CFO e costruisci connessioni che modellano la tua carriera.

• Assumere la responsabilità: sviluppare le tue capacità di leadership in un team internazionale che ti promuove e ti ispira. Soprattutto nell'intensa Stagione di Busy da gennaio a Pasqua, si dà un contributo decisivo al successo dei nostri clienti.

Se non sei ancora sicuro di come la vita quotidiana sembra nell'auditing, allora prova la nostra esperienza virtuale caso. In 3-4 ore è possibile risolvere problemi di business reali e ottenere una visione della pratica.

Con noi contiamo la vostra personalità, le vostre abilità e la vostra volontà di rendere il mondo un po 'meglio. Cos'altro dovreste portare:

• Un prossimo o completato laurea o master in economia, (business) informatica, STEM o un altro campo di studio.

• Entusiasmo per numeri, tendenze digitali e sostenibilità.

• Il desiderio di lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e di lavorare con persone provenienti da culture diverse.

• Forte comunicazione in tedesco e inglese.

• Spirito di squadra e la capacità di risolvere le sfide con idee fresche.

La tua prospettiva – Più di un semplice lavoro
Sappiamo che iniziare la tua carriera può essere emozionante, ma anche impegnativo. Ecco perché vi accompagniamo sulla vostra strada – con un piano chiaro e un forte sostegno:
• Sostegno temporaneo e finanziario: Vi sosteniamo in modo completo nella vostra ulteriore formazione da/per la dipl. Auditori: Non solo si ottiene il supporto finanziario, ma anche la flessibilità per rendere il vostro tempo di apprendimento ottimale.

• Flessibilità che ti si addice: I nostri modelli di tempo di lavoro vi danno la libertà di equilibrio lavoro, apprendimento e tempo libero.

• Mentoraggio e sviluppo: sarete accompagnati da colleghi esperti che vi promuovono e vi ispirano.

• Un team che ti abilita: Con noi, troverai una comunità che valorizza la diversità, celebra le idee e ti incoraggia a crescere oltre te stesso.

Perché PwC? Perché sappiamo cosa è importante per voi. Lavoro significativo che fa la differenza. Una squadra che ti ispira. E l'opportunità di plasmare attivamente il futuro.

Applicare ora e diventare parte della nostra Comunità di Solvers. Insieme formiamo il futuro dell'auditing – digitale, sostenibile e globale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
You are part of a team that not only checks numbers, but recognizes connections. At PwC in the field of audit - financial services (banking), you analyze companies: How successful are they? What are the opportunities and risks? How can they become more sustainable?

Here you work with curious and ambitious people to shape the economy of tomorrow – digitally, sustainably and globally. Each project is unique and offers you the chance to grow and make a difference.

Diversity is our strength. Your perspective counts, and we support you in achieving your goals.

You don’t just want a job, you want to make a difference? Welcome to PwC! Here you can:
• Understand and transform companies: Review consolidated and annual financial statements and ensure that they meet regulatory requirements – on site, in the office or flexibly from the home office.

• Shaping the future digitally: Use cutting-edge tools, AI and data analysis to take auditing to a new level. Your ideas count!

• Promote sustainability: Support the review of ESG reports and accompany companies on their way to greater environmental awareness and social responsibility.

• Build networks: Collaborate with leadership teams and CFOs and build connections that will shape your career.

• Take responsibility: Develop your leadership skills in an international team that promotes and inspires you. Especially in the intensive Busy Season from January to Easter, you make a decisive contribution to the success of our customers.

If you are still unsure what everyday life looks like in auditing, then try our Virtual Case Experience. In 3-4 hours you can solve real business problems and gain an insight into the practice.

With us count your personality, your skills and your will to make the world a bit better. What else you should bring:

• An upcoming or completed bachelor's or master's degree in economics, (business) informatics, STEM or another field of study.

• Enthusiasm for numbers, digital trends and sustainability.

• The desire to work in an international environment and to work with people from different cultures.

• Strong communication in German and English.

• Team spirit and the ability to solve challenges with fresh ideas.

Your perspective – More than just a job
We know that starting your career can be exciting, but also challenging. That’s why we accompany you on your way – with a clear plan and strong support:
• Temporal and financial support: We support you comprehensively in your further education to/from the dipl. Auditors: You not only get financial support, but also the flexibility to make your learning time optimal.

• Flexibility that suits you: Our working time models give you the freedom to balance work, learning and leisure time.

• Mentoring and development: You will be accompanied by experienced colleagues who promote and inspire you.

• A team that empowers you: With us, you’ll find a community that values diversity, celebrates ideas, and encourages you to grow beyond yourself.

Why PwC? Because we know what’s important to you. Meaningful work that makes a difference. A team that inspires you. And the opportunity to actively shape the future.

Apply now and become part of our Community of Solvers. Together we shape the future of auditing – digitally, sustainably and globally.

jobs.description:
• You manage engagements with clients and PwC teams, serving as a key leader within our organization.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them navigate the complexities of AI adoption

• Lead workshops and discussions with clients or internal stakeholders to identify AI use cases, understand business challenges, and align AI tailored solutions.

• Facilitate your clients' advancement in digitization by gathering their requirements and proposing state-of-the-art solutions.

• Anticipate and address potential risks associated with AI implementation, such as data privacy, security, and model performance.

• Implement and continuously expand your knowledge of best practices in technology, data engineering, analytics, and consulting approach.

• A university master's degree or PhD in fields such as artificial intelligence, computer science, physics, mathematics, or any natural sciences or engineering discipline is preferred.

• Over 10 years of work experience evidencing experience with artificial intelligence technologies (such as machine learning, deep learning, advanced statistics and modelling) and more recently in Generative AI (including Agentic AI, GenAI-related cloud technologies, ML engineering).

• As experienced hire, you have a solid track record in delivering and overachieving on your projects and you can rely on your network within AI space.

• Proven experience in AI leadership roles, with a track record of delivering impactful AI solutions. Consulting experienced is considered a plus.

• Proven go-to-market experience within the Swiss market is mandatory, with a strong understanding of local business dynamics and needs.

• Fluency in English with a willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally internationally; German or French language skills are considered a plus.

Anticipa e affronta i potenziali rischi associati all'implementazione dell'AI, come la privacy dei dati, la sicurezza e le performance del modello. Implementa e amplia continuamente le tue conoscenze sulle best practice in tecnologia, data engineering, analytics e approccio consulenziale. Si preferisce una laurea magistrale o un dottorato in campi come intelligenza artificiale, informatica, fisica, matematica o qualsiasi disciplina di scienze naturali o ingegneria. Oltre 10 anni di esperienza lavorativa che dimostri esperienza con tecnologie di intelligenza artificiale (come machine learning, deep learning, statistica avanzata e modellazione) e più recentemente in AI Generativa (inclusa AI Agentiva, tecnologie cloud correlate alla GenAI, ML engineering). In qualità di profilo esperto, hai un solido track record nella delivery e nel superamento degli obiettivi dei tuoi progetti e puoi fare affidamento sulla tua rete nel settore AI. Comprovata esperienza in ruoli di leadership AI, con un track record di delivery di soluzioni AI di impatto. L'esperienza in consulenza è considerata un plus. Comprovata esperienza go-to-market nel mercato svizzero è obbligatoria, con una forte comprensione delle dinamiche e delle esigenze aziendali locali. Fluente in inglese con disponibilità a viaggiare in Svizzera e occasionalmente a livello internazionale; le competenze in tedesco o francese sono considerate un plus.
descriptionByLocale.en:
• You manage engagements with clients and PwC teams, serving as a key leader within our organization.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them navigate the complexities of AI adoption

• Lead workshops and discussions with clients or internal stakeholders to identify AI use cases, understand business challenges, and align AI tailored solutions.

• Facilitate your clients' advancement in digitization by gathering their requirements and proposing state-of-the-art solutions.

• Anticipate and address potential risks associated with AI implementation, such as data privacy, security, and model performance.

• Implement and continuously expand your knowledge of best practices in technology, data engineering, analytics, and consulting approach.

• A university master's degree or PhD in fields such as artificial intelligence, computer science, physics, mathematics, or any natural sciences or engineering discipline is preferred.

• Over 10 years of work experience evidencing experience with artificial intelligence technologies (such as machine learning, deep learning, advanced statistics and modelling) and more recently in Generative AI (including Agentic AI, GenAI-related cloud technologies, ML engineering).

• As experienced hire, you have a solid track record in delivering and overachieving on your projects and you can rely on your network within AI space.

• Proven experience in AI leadership roles, with a track record of delivering impactful AI solutions. Consulting experienced is considered a plus.

• Proven go-to-market experience within the Swiss market is mandatory, with a strong understanding of local business dynamics and needs.

• Fluency in English with a willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally internationally; German or French language skills are considered a plus.

• Anforderungen aufnehmen und modernste Lösungen vorschlagen. Über 10 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit nachweisbarer Erfahrung in Technologien der künstlichen Intelligenz (wie maschinelles Lernen, Deep Learning, fortgeschrittene Statistik und Modellierung) und neuerdings in Generative AI (einschliesslich Agentic AI, GenAI-bezogene Cloud-Technologien, ML-Engineering). Als erfahrene Fachkraft verfügen Sie über eine solide Erfolgsbilanz bei der Umsetzung und Übererfüllung Ihrer Projekte und können sich auf Ihr Netzwerk im KI-Bereich stützen. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in KI-Führungsrollen mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Entwicklung wirkungsvoller KI-Lösungen. Beratungserfahrung gilt als Plus. jobs.title: Senior Associate / Assistant Manager - Audit Trade, Industries & Services
jobs.description:
In deiner Rolle als erfahrener Profi im Bereich Audit – Trade, Industries & Services bei PwC bist du Teil eines Teams, bei dem deine Erfahrung und Perspektive zählt. Wir legen großen Wert auf Vielfalt und unterstützen dich dabei, deine beruflichen Ziele zu erreichen, deine Kompetenzen weiter auszubauen und neue Herausforderungen zu meistern.

Du gestaltest die Wirtschaft von morgen mit – digital, nachhaltig und global.

• Du prüfst Jahres- und Konzernrechnungen bei nationalen und internationalen Konzernen und Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Industrie, Handel und dem Dienstleistungssektor.

• Geschäftsprozesse werden von dir geprüft und du leistest Hilfestellung bei Fragen zur Rechnungslegung nach verschiedenen Standards (OR, IFRS, Swiss GAAP FER, US GAAP).

• Mit dem/der Engagement Manager:in arbeitest du an der Planung, Durchführung und Finalisierung verschiedener Prüfaufträge sowie verschiedener Sonderprüfungen und bist dabei im direkten Austausch mit weiteren Fachspezialist:innen.

• Du bist Teil der digitalen Revolution der Wirtschaftsprüfung, indem du unsere digitalen Prüftools und -ansätze einsetzt und mithilfst, sie zu verbessern.

• Der Erwerb von vertieften Kenntnissen eines breiten Kundenspektrums und das Aufbauen sowie Pflegen von Kundenbeziehungen sprechen dich an.

• Du wirst von uns in deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung durch On- und Off-the-Job-Coaching unterstützt, um deine langfristigen Karriereziele zu erreichen.

• Als Teil eines inspirierenden, diversifizierten Team befindest du dich in einem internationalen Netzwerk und erhältst regelmässig Feedback von Kolleg:innen und Vorgesetzten.

• Du absolvierst die Ausbildung zum/zur Dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in oder hast diese soeben abgeschlossen.

• Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung mit und hast dabei Einblicke in betriebswirtschaftliche Prüfungen von Unternehmen gewonnen.

• Du hast ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch an dich und das Team und möchtest aktiv die Digitalisierung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung vorantreiben.

• Du bist motiviert und gestaltest Lösungen mit, die Ansprüche unserer Kund:innen zu übertreffen.

• Du bist bereit, von Anfang an Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich in einem Umfeld mit einer aktiven Coachingkultur zu bewegen.

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel tuo ruolo di professionista esperto nel dipartimento Audit – Commercio, Industrie e Servizi di PwC, fai parte di un team in cui contano la tua esperienza e la tua prospettiva. Attribuiamo grande importanza alla diversità e ti supportiamo nel raggiungimento dei tuoi obiettivi professionali, nello sviluppo ulteriore delle tue capacità e nell'affrontare nuove sfide. Contribuirai a plasmare l'economia di domani: digitale, sostenibile e globale.
• Effettuate la revisione dei bilanci annuali e consolidati di enti e società nazionali e internazionali dei settori industriale, commerciale e dei servizi.
• Verificherete i processi aziendali e fornirete assistenza in caso di domande sulla contabilità secondo diversi standard (OR, IFRS, Swiss GAAP FER, US GAAP).
• Lavorerai con l'Engagement Manager alla pianificazione, implementazione e finalizzazione di vari ordini di test nonché di vari test speciali e sarai in contatto diretto con altri specialisti.
• Farai parte della rivoluzione digitale nell'auditing utilizzando e contribuendo a migliorare i nostri strumenti e approcci all'auditing digitale.
• Acquisire una conoscenza approfondita di un'ampia gamma di clienti e costruire e mantenere relazioni con i clienti ti attrae.
• Ti supporteremo nel tuo sviluppo professionale e personale attraverso coaching dentro e fuori dal lavoro per raggiungere i tuoi obiettivi di carriera a lungo termine.
• Come parte di un team stimolante e diversificato, farai parte di una rete internazionale e riceverai feedback regolari da colleghi e superiori.
• Stai completando o hai appena completato la formazione per diventare un auditor qualificato.
• Hai almeno due anni di esperienza professionale nella revisione contabile e hai acquisito conoscenze in materia di audit aziendali delle aziende.
• Possiedi forti capacità analitiche, elevati standard di qualità per te stesso e per il team e vorresti promuovere attivamente la digitalizzazione nell'auditing.
• Sei motivato e aiuti a progettare soluzioni per superare le richieste dei nostri clienti.
• Sei pronto ad assumerti responsabilità fin dall'inizio e a lavorare in un ambiente con una cultura del coaching attiva.
• Hai ottime competenze scritte e parlate di tedesco e inglese.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In your role as an experienced professional in the Audit – Trade, Industries & Services department at PwC, you are part of a team where your experience and perspective count. We attach great importance to diversity and support you in achieving your professional goals, further developing your skills and mastering new challenges. You will help shape the economy of tomorrow – digital, sustainable and global.
• You audit annual and consolidated financial statements of national and international corporations and companies from the industrial, commercial and service sectors.
• You will check business processes and provide assistance with questions about accounting according to various standards (OR, IFRS, Swiss GAAP FER, US GAAP).
• You will work with the Engagement Manager on the planning, implementation and finalization of various test orders as well as various special tests and will be in direct contact with other specialists.
• You will be part of the digital revolution in auditing by using and helping to improve our digital auditing tools and approaches.
• Acquiring in-depth knowledge of a wide range of customers and building and maintaining customer relationships appeals to you.
• We will support you in your professional and personal development through on- and off-the-job coaching to achieve your long-term career goals.
• As part of an inspiring, diversified team, you will be in an international network and receive regular feedback from colleagues and superiors.
• You are completing or have just completed training to become a qualified auditor.
• You have at least two years of professional experience in auditing and have gained insights into business audits of companies.
• You have strong analytical skills, high quality standards for yourself and the team and would like to actively promote digitalization in auditing.
• You are motivated and help design solutions to exceed the demands of our customers.
• You are ready to take on responsibility right from the start and work in an environment with an active coaching culture.
• You have very good written and spoken German and English skills.

• Vous possédez de très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais, à l'écrit et à l'oral.

jobs.title: Life Transformation Aktuar/-in – Manager/in
jobs.description:
• Du berätst führende Lebens-(Rück-) Versicherungsgesellschaften in der Schweiz im Rahmen strategischer Transformationsprojekte, z. B. Systemmigrationen, Prozessoptimierungen oder Modernisierungen von aktuariellen Funktionen.

• Du bringst aktuarielles Fachwissen in multidisziplinäre Teams ein und arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen aktuariellen, IT- und Business-Funktionen.

• Du analysierst und optimierst bestehende aktuariellen Modelle, Tarifierungs- oder Reservierungsprozesse.

• Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einzelne Projektstreams oder leitest kleinere Projektteams.

• Du unterstützt beim Auf- und Ausbau von Kundenbeziehungen und trägst zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Beratungsangebots im Bereich Life Insurance bei.

• Du verfügst über einen Universitätsabschluss in Mathematik, Statistik, Actuarial Science oder Naturwissenschaften.

• Du hast 5–8 Jahre relevante aktuarielle Berufserfahrung im Lebensversicherungsmarkt, sei es in einer (Rück-)versicherungsgesellschaft oder in der Beratung in der Schweiz.

• Du bist Aktuar SAV oder verfügst über eine äquivalente ausländische Qualifikation.

• Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Tarifierung, Reservierung oder Reporting (OR, IFRS 17) von Lebensversicherungsprodukten.

• Du hast bereits erste Führungs- und Projekterfahrung, idealerweise in grösseren Transformationsprojekten.

• Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch – weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus.

• Zertifizierungen in Cloud-Technologien (z. B. Azure, AWS) oder Erfahrung mit Prozessautomatisierung bzw. -orchestrierung (z. B. Camunda) sind von Vorteil.

titleByLocale.it: Attuario della Trasformazione della Vita – Manager
titleByLocale.fr: Actuaire de transformation de vie – Gestionnaire

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Consulti le principali società di assicurazione vita (e riassicurazione) in Svizzera nell'ambito di progetti di trasformazione strategica, ad esempio migrazioni di sistema, ottimizzazioni di processo o modernizzazioni di funzioni attuariali. Porti la tua esperienza specialistica attuariale in team multidisciplinari e lavori all'interfaccia tra funzioni attuariali, IT e business. Analizzi e ottimizzi modelli attuariali esistenti, processi di tariffazione o di riservazione. Assumi la responsabilità di singoli flussi di progetto o dirigi piccoli team di progetto. Supporti la creazione e lo sviluppo di relazioni con i clienti e contribuisci allo sviluppo della nostra offerta di consulenza nel settore assicurativo vita. ##
• Requisiti - Hai un titolo di studio universitario in Matematica, Statistica, Scienze attuariali o Scienze naturali. - Hai 5-8 anni di esperienza lavorativa attuariale rilevante nel mercato assicurativo vita, sia in una società di assicurazione (o riassicurazione) che in consulenza in Svizzera. - Sei attuario SAV o hai una qualifica straniera equivalente. - Hai esperienza pratica nella tariffazione, nella riservazione o nella rendicontazione (OR, IFRS 17) di prodotti assicurativi vita. - Hai già esperienza di leadership e di progetto, idealmente in progetti di trasformazione più grandi. - Commuichi in modo sicuro e negoziale in tedesco e inglese - altre lingue sono un vantaggio. - Certificazioni in tecnologie cloud (ad es. Azure, AWS) o esperienza con automazione o orchestrazione di processi (ad es. Camunda) sono vantaggiose.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description You advise leading life (re)insurance companies in Switzerland on strategic transformation projects, such as system migrations, process optimizations or modernizations of actuarial functions. You bring actuarial expertise into multidisciplinary teams and work at the interface between actuarial, IT and business functions. You analyze and optimize existing actuarial models, pricing or reserving processes. You take responsibility for individual project streams or lead smaller project teams. You support the development and expansion of customer relationships and contribute to the further development of our consulting services in the life insurance sector. ##
• Requirements - You have a university degree in mathematics, statistics, actuarial science or natural sciences. - You have 5-8 years of relevant actuarial work experience in the life insurance market, either in an (re)insurance company or in consulting in Switzerland. - You are an Aktuar SAV or have an equivalent foreign qualification. - You have practical experience in pricing, reserving or reporting (OR, IFRS 17) of life insurance products. - You already have initial leadership and project experience, ideally in larger transformation projects. - You communicate in a negotiation-safe manner in German and English - other languages are a plus. - Certifications in cloud technologies (e.g. Azure, AWS) or experience with process automation or orchestration (e.g. Camunda) are advantageous.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siete parte di una squadra che non solo controlla i numeri, ma riconosce le connessioni. A PwC nell'ambito dell'audit - servizi finanziari (banche, asset manager, assicurazioni) si analizzano le aziende: Quanto hanno successo? Quali sono le opportunità e i rischi? Come possono diventare più sostenibili?

Qui si lavora con persone curiosi e ambiziose per plasmare l'economia di domani – digitalmente, in modo sostenibile e globale. Ogni progetto è unico e vi offre la possibilità di crescere e fare la differenza.

La diversità è la nostra forza. La tua prospettiva conta e ti sosteniamo nel raggiungere i tuoi obiettivi.

Non vuoi solo un lavoro, vuoi fare la differenza? Benvenuti a PwC! Qui puoi:
• Comprendere e trasformare le aziende: rivedere i bilanci consolidati e annuali e garantire che soddisfino i requisiti normativi – in loco, in ufficio o in modo flessibile dall'ufficio di casa.

• Definire il futuro digitalmente: utilizzare strumenti all'avanguardia, AI e analisi dei dati per prendere l'auditing a un nuovo livello. Le tue idee valgono!

• Promuovere la sostenibilità: sostenere la revisione dei rapporti ESG e accompagnare le aziende verso una maggiore consapevolezza ambientale e responsabilità sociale.

• Costruisci reti: Collabora con team di leadership e CFO e costruisci connessioni che modellano la tua carriera.

• Assumere la responsabilità: sviluppare le tue capacità di leadership in un team internazionale che ti promuove e ti ispira. Soprattutto nell'intensa Stagione di Busy da gennaio a Pasqua, si dà un contributo decisivo al successo dei nostri clienti.

Se non sei ancora sicuro di come la vita quotidiana sembra nell'auditing, allora prova la nostra esperienza virtuale caso. In 3-4 ore è possibile risolvere problemi di business reali e ottenere una visione della pratica.

Con noi contiamo la vostra personalità, le vostre abilità e la vostra volontà di rendere il mondo un po 'meglio. Cos'altro dovreste portare:

• Un prossimo o completato laurea o master in economia, (business) informatica, STEM o un altro campo di studio.

• Entusiasmo per numeri, tendenze digitali e sostenibilità.

• Il desiderio di lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e di lavorare con persone provenienti da culture diverse.

• Forte comunicazione in tedesco e inglese.

• Spirito di squadra e la capacità di risolvere le sfide con idee fresche.

La tua prospettiva – Più di un semplice lavoro
Sappiamo che iniziare la tua carriera può essere emozionante, ma anche impegnativo. Ecco perché vi accompagniamo sulla vostra strada – con un piano chiaro e un forte sostegno:
• Sostegno temporaneo e finanziario: Vi sosteniamo in modo completo nella vostra ulteriore formazione da/per la dipl. Auditori: Non solo si ottiene il supporto finanziario, ma anche la flessibilità per rendere il vostro tempo di apprendimento ottimale.

• Flessibilità che ti si addice: I nostri modelli di tempo di lavoro vi danno la libertà di equilibrio lavoro, apprendimento e tempo libero.

• Mentoraggio e sviluppo: sarete accompagnati da colleghi esperti che vi promuovono e vi ispirano.

• Un team che ti abilita: Con noi, troverai una comunità che valorizza la diversità, celebra le idee e ti incoraggia a crescere oltre te stesso.

Perché PwC? Perché sappiamo cosa è importante per voi. Lavoro significativo che fa la differenza. Una squadra che ti ispira. E l'opportunità di plasmare attivamente il futuro.

Applicare ora e diventare parte della nostra Comunità di Solvers. Insieme formiamo il futuro dell'auditing – digitale, sostenibile e globale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
You are part of a team that not only checks numbers, but recognizes connections. At PwC in the area of audit - financial services (banks, asset managers, insurance) you analyze companies: How successful are they? What are the opportunities and risks? How can they become more sustainable?

Here you work with curious and ambitious people to shape the economy of tomorrow – digitally, sustainably and globally. Each project is unique and offers you the chance to grow and make a difference.

Diversity is our strength. Your perspective counts, and we support you in achieving your goals.

You don’t just want a job, you want to make a difference? Welcome to PwC! Here you can:
• Understand and transform companies: Review consolidated and annual financial statements and ensure that they meet regulatory requirements – on site, in the office or flexibly from the home office.

• Shaping the future digitally: Use cutting-edge tools, AI and data analysis to take auditing to a new level. Your ideas count!

• Promote sustainability: Support the review of ESG reports and accompany companies on their way to greater environmental awareness and social responsibility.

• Build networks: Collaborate with leadership teams and CFOs and build connections that will shape your career.

• Take responsibility: Develop your leadership skills in an international team that promotes and inspires you. Especially in the intensive Busy Season from January to Easter, you make a decisive contribution to the success of our customers.

If you are still unsure what everyday life looks like in auditing, then try our Virtual Case Experience. In 3-4 hours you can solve real business problems and gain an insight into the practice.

With us count your personality, your skills and your will to make the world a bit better. What else you should bring:

• An upcoming or completed bachelor's or master's degree in economics, (business) informatics, STEM or another field of study.

• Enthusiasm for numbers, digital trends and sustainability.

• The desire to work in an international environment and to work with people from different cultures.

• Strong communication in German and English.

• Team spirit and the ability to solve challenges with fresh ideas.

Your perspective – More than just a job
We know that starting your career can be exciting, but also challenging. That’s why we accompany you on your way – with a clear plan and strong support:
• Temporal and financial support: We support you comprehensively in your further education to/from the dipl. Auditors: You not only get financial support, but also the flexibility to make your learning time optimal.

• Flexibility that suits you: Our working time models give you the freedom to balance work, learning and leisure time.

• Mentoring and development: You will be accompanied by experienced colleagues who promote and inspire you.

• A team that empowers you: With us, you’ll find a community that values diversity, celebrates ideas, and encourages you to grow beyond yourself.

Why PwC? Because we know what’s important to you. Meaningful work that makes a difference. A team that inspires you. And the opportunity to actively shape the future.

Apply now and become part of our Community of Solvers. Together we shape the future of auditing – digitally, sustainably and globally.

jobs.description:
• Provide advice to Swiss and international clients on Swiss, EU and US customs and trade regulations, including classification, valuation, origin, preferential trade agreements and export controls and sanctions.

• Assist the team and clients in understanding the impact of customs and trade laws on their business operations and supply chain.

• Have contact with clients, local and foreign Customs Authorities as well as with Customs, Trade and VAT experts from our international PwC network.

• You are working in our VAT and Customs team in Zurich.

• Participate in the development of our indirect tax practice.

• A degree in accounting, economics, business or law or similar education in the field of International Customs and Trade.

• High interest for Customs and Trade area.

• Fluency in English is required, as well as in German, French or Italian.

• 2 – 3 years of consulting experience in the area of customs and trade.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills as well as consulting and team oriented mindset and take on responsibility for your projects.

• You are helping continuously to improve our service offerings.

jobs.title: Manager - SAP Master Data Governance Consulting
jobs.description:
As one of the leading global professional services firms, PwC offers a wide range of consulting services across various industries, helping organisations navigate complex challenges and achieve their strategic goals. We work closely with clients to provide tailored solutions that address their specific needs, whether it's developing innovative strategies, improving operational efficiency, or leveraging emerging technologies.

• Lead and support large-scale projects focusing on S/4HANA or SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) within Switzerland and internationally.

• Collaborate with clients to assess and enhance their master data governance processes, leveraging SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

• Guide clients from the conceptualization of initial ideas through to successful operational implementation, ensuring seamless integration of SAP MDG solutions.

• Design and enhance SAP standard software solutions, tailoring them to meet specific client needs and industry standards.

• Develop custom applications and integrate various software solutions to optimize client operations and data management strategies.

• Bachelor's or master's degree in business, IT, engineering, business information systems, or a related field.

• 3 to 6 years of experience in process consulting and implementation of SAP solutions, with a focus on SAP Master Data Governance and a deep understanding of associated business processes.

• Proven expertise in implementing SAP MDG for Customer, Vendor, Material, or Financial domains, translating business process requirements into technical solutions.

• Experience in process modeling, including entity and business activity changes, workflow design, data replication techniques, and master data conversion.

• Strong analytical skills with practical experience in process analysis and design across various industries.

• Fluency in English and German; additional languages are advantageous.

jobs.title: Manager / Senior Manager - Cyber Technology and Transformation
jobs.description:
Are you ready to contribute to the successful delivery of Cyber Technology & Transformation engagements?
This is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing Cyber Technology and Transformation team. We support our clients along the whole cyber security journey, ranging from technology assessments, identification and implementation of cyber solutions, defining cyber strategy and many more. You benefit from a great team to work with and from our broad engagements enabling you to growth personally and professionally.

• Be part of our diverse Cybersecurity team and play a pivotal role in delivering security engagements spanning Exposure Management, Security Architecture, Cloud Security, and many more.

• Serve as key contact for our clients, taking on the end-to-end management and successful delivery of our engagements.

• Provide strategic guidance to clients to support them on their cyber journey.

• Drive the evaluation and implementation of cyber technologies to improve the cybersecurity maturity of our clients.

• Build and drive your own cyber capability, from business development to contributing to the development of innovative services within our cyber technology and transformation practice.

• Shape and mentor cross-functional teams to develop and execute long term client relationships and to accelerate a collaborative work environment.

• Min. 5 years of relevant experience in Cybersecurity and prior consulting experience from either a consultancy firm or an internal corporate consulting function or role.

• Master's or bachelor's degree or an equivalent professional qualification. Additional certificates such as CISSP, CISM, SSCP are a plus.

• Knowledge and hands on experience in managing security projects in key domains such as security operations, security architecture, Identity and Access Management (IAM), cloud security etc.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with all levels of management and staff.

• Fluent in English; German or French are a plus.

jobs.title: Manager Capital Markets
jobs.description:
• You are part of the high performing Capital Markets and Accounting Advisory Solutions (CMAAS) team executing and delivering on transactions projects including IPOs, debt & equity offerings and cross border transactions (e.g.144As).

• You develop new and extend existing relationships with our clients and actively support the client targeting and acquisition process.

• You are in the driver seat of your own responsibility, flexibility and development.

• You develop your leadership skills and share your expertise and experience actively by teaching, coaching and mentoring others.

• You are a Certified Public Accountant (Switzerland and/or other country).

• You have strong knowledge of accounting standards (IFRS, US GAAP and/or Swiss GAAP FER), industry credentials and transaction experience, if possible.

• You have 4-5 years experience as audit senior / manager or similar positions. You have a track record of project management, client management and high risk & services orientation.

• You have excellent English, German or French (both written and verbal) skills. You have strong communication skills, are very client-oriented, flexible and willing to travel and work in an international network.

• You drive your career together with your coach by setting clear career objectives and making conscious career choices.

• You bring in your external network and leverage your personal relationships.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Cyber Cloud Security
jobs.description:
Would you like to be part of a team which pushes cloud adoption forward? Are you ready to push the market with your own service portfolio on cloud security solutions? Then you are looking at the right job! Support the PwC Cybersecurity practice by shaping and developing our cyber cloud vision, being an active part of our Cybersecurity leadership team, and helping our clients to realise the benefits of cloud in a secure way.

Your Skill Set
• A decade of experience, ideally with a focus on consulting assignments, securing cloud deployments to at least one of Azure, GCP or AWS, and the ability to articulate the differences in security offerrings between all three.

• Hands on experience with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) capabilities and the ability to articulate when and why solutions like Wiz, Palo Alto and others can be relevant to help secure a cloud deployment.

• A bachelor's and master's degree in IT, Communications, or Cyber Security. Information Security certifications such as CISSP, CISA or CISM. Ideally also experience with highly regulated environments, ISO270001 and ISO42001 (AI) are preferred.

• Demonstrate a proven track record in implementing secure cloud deployments from initial assessment to designing and implementing core cloud security capabilities, including highly automated and optimised processes.

• Exhibit strong presentation, project management and delivery skills, coupled with strong problem-solving skills. A blend of consulting and industry / in-house experience would be highly desirable.

• Relevant project methodology certificates (e.g., SCRUM, SAFe, PRINCE2, IPMA or PMP) complete your profile.

• Fluent in English. German or French desirable.

• A decade of experience, ideally with a focus on consulting assignments, securing cloud deployments to at least one of Azure, GCP or AWS, and the ability to articulate the differences in security offerrings between all three.

jobs.title: Praktikant:in - Steuerberatung (6 Monate)
jobs.description:
Im Bereich Unternehmenssteuern geht es nicht nur darum, Unternehmen bei der Einhaltung von Vorschriften zu unterstützen. Wir beraten national oder international tätige Unternehmen auch im Hinblick auf die relevanten Steuervorschriften und -entwicklungen. So können sie effiziente Strukturen aufbauen, die steuerlichen Auswirkungen möglicher Geschäftsmodelle berücksichtigen und Steuerrisiken vermeiden.
Als wertvolles Teammitglied berätst du Kund:innen (sowohl Unternehmen als auch Privatpersonen) in verschiedenen Steuerangelegenheiten und wirkst bei der Verwaltung anspruchsvoller Projekte mit.

• Unterstütze die Beratung juristischer Personen aus verschiedenen Branchen und Industrien in Fragen der Steuerbelange.

• Bearbeite herausfordernde und komplexe steuerliche Anfragen unserer nationalen und internationalen Kund: innen, um bestmögliche Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

• Führe anspruchsvolle Projekte wie national- und grenzüberschreitende Unternehmensumstrukturierungen, Kauf- und Verkaufstransaktionen sowie Anpassungen der Wertschöpfungskette durch.

• Profitiere vom erfolgreichen Austausch in der gesamten Steuer- und Rechtsabteilung, um dich sowohl persönlich als auch fachlich schnell weiterzuentwickeln.

• Masterabschluss an einer Universität oder Fachhochschule, idealerweise in Wirtschafts- oder Rechtswissenschaften.

• Zeige dein Flair für rechtliche Fragestellungen und betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge sowie deine Zahlen-Affinität. Bring aktiv deine Interessen ein und trage somit zum Erfolg unseres Teams bei.

• Zeige ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Steuern und bringe idealerweise bereits erste Vorkenntnisse mit. Sei flexibel, ausdauernd und offen für herausfordernde sowie komplexe Situationen.

• Sei stilsicher in Deutsch und verfüge über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

titleByLocale.it: Interno - consulenza fiscale (6 mesi)
titleByLocale.fr: Stagiaire - consultation fiscale (6 mois)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Nel settore delle imposte aziendali, non si tratta solo di sostenere le aziende nel rispetto delle normative. Consigliamo anche le aziende nazionali o internazionali per quanto riguarda le relative normative e sviluppi fiscali. In questo modo, possono costruire strutture efficienti, tenere conto delle implicazioni fiscali dei possibili modelli di business ed evitare rischi fiscali. In qualità di membro del team prezioso, si consiglia ai clienti: in varie questioni fiscali (sia aziende che individui) e partecipare alla gestione di progetti impegnativi. - Sostenere le persone giuridiche di varie industrie e industrie in materia di questioni fiscali. - Modificare richieste fiscali complesse e complesse dai nostri clienti nazionali e internazionali per ottenere i migliori risultati possibili. - Esegui progetti impegnativi come la ristrutturazione, l'acquisto e le operazioni di vendita e la ristrutturazione delle imprese nazionali e transfrontaliere. - Approfittate dello scambio di successo nell'intero reparto fiscale e legale per svilupparvi sia personalmente che professionalmente. ##
• Requisiti - Master's degree in un'università o college, idealmente in economia o scienze legali. - Mostra il tuo fascino per domande legali e relazioni commerciali, così come la tua affinità numero. Prendere i vostri interessi attivamente e contribuire al successo del nostro team. - No. Mostra un forte interesse per le tasse e idealmente portare prima conoscenza preventiva. Sii flessibile, duraturo e aperto a situazioni difficili e complesse. - No. Siate stilistici in tedesco e hanno ottime competenze in inglese.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Descrizione In the field of corporate taxes, it is not just about supporting companies in compliance with regulations. We also advise national or international companies with regard to the relevant tax regulations and developments. In this way, they can build efficient structures, take into account the tax implications of possible business models and avoid tax risks. As a valuable team member, you advise customers: in various tax matters (both companies and individuals) and participate in managing challenging projects. - Support legal persons from various industries and industries in matters of tax matters. - Edit challenging and complex tax enquiries from our national and international customers to achieve the best possible results. - Performs challenging projects such as national and cross-border corporate restructuring, purchasing and sales transactions and adaptations to the value chain. - Benefit from the successful exchange in the entire tax and legal department to develop you both personally and professionally. ##
• Requisiti - Master's degree at a university or college, ideally in economics or legal sciences. - Show your flair for legal questions and business relationships as well as your number affinity. Take your interests actively and contribute to the success of our team. - Show a strong interest in taxes and ideally bring first prior knowledge. Be flexible, enduring and open to challenging and complex situations. - Be stylistic in German and have very good English skills.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Descrizione Dans le domaine de l'impôt sur les sociétés, il ne s'agit pas seulement de soutenir les entreprises en conformité avec la réglementation. Nous conseillons également les entreprises nationales ou internationales en ce qui concerne les réglementations et les développements fiscaux pertinents. Ils peuvent ainsi mettre en place des structures efficaces, tenir compte des implications fiscales des modèles d'affaires possibles et éviter les risques fiscaux. En tant que membre précieux de l'équipe, vous conseillez les clients : en matière fiscale (entreprises et particuliers) et participez à la gestion de projets difficiles. - Soutenir les personnes morales de diverses industries en matière fiscale. - Modifier les demandes de renseignements fiscales complexes et difficiles de nos clients nationaux et internationaux pour obtenir les meilleurs résultats possibles. - Réaliser des projets difficiles tels que la restructuration des entreprises nationales et transfrontalières, les opérations d'achat et de vente et les adaptations de la chaîne de valeur. - Profitez de l'échange réussi dans l'ensemble du département fiscal et juridique pour vous développer personnellement et professionnellement. ##
• Requisiti - Maîtrise dans une université ou un collège, idéalement en sciences économiques ou juridiques. - Montrez votre style pour les questions juridiques et les relations d'affaires ainsi que votre affinité de nombre. Prenez vos intérêts activement et contribuez au succès de notre équipe. - Oui. Montrez un fort intérêt pour les impôts et idéalement apporter une première connaissance préalable. Soyez flexible, durable et ouvert à des situations difficiles et complexes. - Oui. Soyez stylistique en allemand et avez de très bonnes compétences en anglais.

jobs.title: Accounting- und Reportingspezialist:in mit Schwerpunkt Swiss GAAP FER
jobs.description:
• Du berätst bei der Einführung von kapitalmarktfähigen Reportings. Darüber hinaus leitest du unsere Kunden bei der Umstellung der Rechnungslegung auf Swiss GAAP FER und IFRS an und bist Ansprechpartner:in zu komplexen Bilanzierungsfragen (Swiss GAAP FER, IFRS und Obligationenrecht).

• Du unterstützt die Kunden bei der Aufbereitung von Finanzinformationen insbesondere bei Unternehmenstransaktionen (z.B. Carve-out Financial Statements).

• Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei der digitalen Transformation von Finanz- und Accountingprozessen.

• Durch die Leitung von (Teil)Projekten übernimmst du zunehmend mehr Verantwortung.

• Du entwickelst neue und baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen aus und unterstützt aktiv den Akquisitionsprozess.

• Unser Erfolgsgeheimnis liegt in der Teamarbeit! Wir schätzen die persönliche Interaktion und Zusammenarbeit im Team und leben deine individuelle Flexibilität.

• Du bist Schweizer Wirtschaftsprüfer:in oder verfügst über einen ähnlichen Abschluss (z.B. eidg. dipl. Experte in Rechnungslegung und Controlling) oder du stehst kurz vor dem Abschluss der Ausbildung.

• Du bringst mindestens vier Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Prüfung, der Beratung oder in einer Accounting- und Reportingfunktion mit. Erfahrung im Bereich Konsolidierung bzw. mit Konzernrechnungen sind von Vorteil.

• Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse des Rechnungslegungsstandards Swiss GAAP FER und der Rechnungslegung nach Obligationenrecht. IFRS Kenntnisse sind ein Plus.

• Vorzugsweise hast du Erfahrung mit BEPS Pillar 2.

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- oder Französischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Im Weiteren fühlst du dich sicher in der Kommunikation in Englisch.

• Dein Organisationstalent und deine Projektmanagement Fähigkeiten zeichnen dich aus.

titleByLocale.it: Specialista di contabilità e reporting: con un focus su Swiss GAAP FER
titleByLocale.en: Accounting and Reporting Specialist with Focus on Swiss GAAP FER
titleByLocale.de: Accounting- und Reportingspezialist:in mit Schwerpunkt Swiss GAAP FER
titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste en comptabilité et en reporting avec un focus sur Swiss GAAP FER

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Du consigli per l'introduzione di reportistica capital market-friendly. Inoltre, guidai i nostri clienti nella transizione della contabilità verso Swiss GAAP FER e IFRS e sei il punto di contatto per domande complesse di bilanciamento (Swiss GAAP FER, IFRS e diritto delle obbligazioni). Du supporta i clienti nella raccolta di informazioni finanziarie, in particolare per le transazioni aziendali (ad esempio, Carve-out Financial Statements). Supporta i nostri clienti nella trasformazione digitale dei processi finanziari e contabili. Gestisci (parziali) progetti e assumi sempre più responsabilità. Sviluppa nuove e mantieni relazioni con i clienti e supporta attivamente il processo di acquisizione. Il nostro segreto di successo è la collaborazione! Apprezziamo l'interazione personale e la collaborazione all'interno del team e viviamo la tua flexibilità individuale. ##
• Requisiti - Contabile o esperto in contabilità con un diploma di esperto in contabilità e controllo (ad esempio, esperto federale in contabilità e controllo) o sei in corso di formazione. - Ha almeno quattro anni di esperienza nel campo della revisione, consulenza o contabilità e reporting. - Conoscenze solide del standard di contabilità Swiss GAAP FER e del diritto delle obbligazioni. Conoscenze di IFRS sono un plus. - Preferibilmente hai esperienza con BEPS Pillar 2. - Conoscenze eccellenti del tedesco o francese in parola e scrittura. Inoltre, ti senti sicuro nella comunicazione in inglese. - Il tuo talento organizzativo e le tue capacità di gestione dei progetti ti distinguono.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description You advise on the introduction of capital market-friendly reporting. Additionally, you guide our clients through the transition of their accounting to Swiss GAAP FER and IFRS and are the point of contact for complex balance sheet questions (Swiss GAAP FER, IFRS, and Obligation Law). You support clients in the preparation of financial information, especially for corporate transactions (e.g., Carve-out Financial Statements). Support our clients in the digital transformation of financial and accounting processes. Manage (partial) projects and take on more responsibility. Develop new and maintain client relationships and actively support the acquisition process. Our success secret is teamwork! We appreciate personal interaction and collaboration within the team and live your individual flexibility. ##
• Requirements - Swiss Certified Accountant or have a similar qualification (e.g., federal diploma in accounting and controlling) or are about to complete your training. - Have at least four years of experience in auditing, consulting, or accounting and reporting. - Have solid knowledge of the accounting standard Swiss GAAP FER and the accounting law. IFRS knowledge is a plus. - Preferably have experience with BEPS Pillar 2. - Have excellent German or French language skills in speech and writing. Furthermore, feel secure in communication in English. - Your organizational talent and project management skills distinguish you.

Connaissances en IFRS sont un plus. - Préférez avoir de l'expérience avec BEPS Pillar 2. - Avez des compétences linguistiques excellentes en allemand ou français en parole et en écriture. En outre, vous vous sentez sûr dans la communication en anglais. - Votre talent organisationnel et vos compétences de gestion de projet vous distinguent.

jobs.title: Director in Cybersecurity Technology & Transformation
jobs.description:
As a Director, you will lead a global delivery team and work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex cyber security issues from strategy to execution. You will help to continue the exciting growth of our cybersecurity practice focusing on Manufacturing, Pharma and Industrial Products industries. PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include but are not limited to:
Identify gaps in the market and spot opportunities to create value propositions to develop and grow cyber business.
Look for opportunities to scale efficiencies and new ways of working across multiple projects and environments.

• You will have the chance to pursue and deliver large and complex opportunities to solve our clients' security challenges via Transformation programs.This includes delivering Supply chain, OT, IAM, Managed Services Transformation programmes on a global scale, advising clients on how to define
Their Target Operating models to deal with IT-OT convergence, and building a winning team to continue our exciting growth in this space.
• You will be creating an environment where people and technology thrive together to accomplish more than they could apart.

• You will be driving and taking an ownership for developing strategic client relationships that help deliver what is best for our people and stakeholders

• You will have an influence and facilitate the creation of long-term relationships which add value to the firm and our clients

• 10+ years' experience in Manufacturing, Pharma, or Industrial Products.

• Strong communication, consulting, and persuasion skills.

• Fluent in English; German or French is a plus.

• Expertise in delivering complex security transformation projects.

• Collaborate with IT, Risk, Manufacturing, and Security teams.

• Build strategic relationships with clients and vendors.

• Experience with cybersecurity functions (e.g., OT Security, supply chain, incident response) and regulations (NIS2, EU CRA).

• Leadership and business development experience in multi-cultural environments.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Knowledge of industry standards (IEC-62243, NIST CS).

• Relevant certifications (CISSP, GICSP, etc.) beneficial.

titleByLocale.it: Direttore in Cybersecurity Technology & Transformation
titleByLocale.fr: Directeur in Cybersecurity Technology & Transformation

descriptionByLocale.it: Come Director, guiderai un team di delivery globale e lavorerai all'interno di un gruppo di problem solver, contribuendo a risolvere problemi complessi di sicurezza informatica dalla strategia all'esecuzione. Contribuirai a sostenere la crescita entusiasmante della nostra practice di cybersecurity, con focus sui settori Manifatturiero, Pharma e Prodotti Industriali. Le competenze e responsabilità professionali di PwC per questo livello manageriale includono, ma non si limitano a: Identificare lacune nel mercato e cogliere opportunità per creare value proposition al fine di sviluppare e far crescere il business nella cybersecurity. Individuare opportunità per scalare l'efficienza e trovare nuovi modi di lavorare su più progetti e ambienti. Avrai la possibilità di acquisire e portare a termine opportunità grandi e complesse per risolvere le sfide di sicurezza dei clienti attraverso programmi di trasformazione. Ciò include la gestione di programmi di trasformazione relativi a Supply chain, OT, IAM e Managed Services su scala globale, la consulenza ai clienti su come definire i propri Target Operating Model per affrontare la convergenza IT-OT, e la creazione di un team vincente per continuare la nostra entusiasmante crescita in questo ambito. Creerai un ambiente in cui persone e tecnologia prospereranno insieme per raggiungere risultati superiori a quelli possibili singolarmente. Guiderai e ti approprierai dello sviluppo di relazioni strategiche con i clienti che contribuiscano a portare il meglio per le nostre persone e i nostri stakeholder. Avrai influenza e faciliterai la creazione di relazioni a lungo termine che aggiungano valore all'azienda e ai nostri clienti. Oltre 10 anni di esperienza nei settori Manifatturiero, Pharma o Prodotti Industriali. Solide capacità di comunicazione, consulenza e persuasione. Fluente in inglese; il tedesco o il francese sono un plus. Competenza nel portare a termine progetti complessi di trasformazione della sicurezza. Collaborare con team IT, Risk, Manufacturing e Security. Costruire relazioni strategiche con clienti e fornitori. Esperienza con funzioni di cybersecurity (es. OT Security, supply chain, incident response) e normative (NIS2, EU CRA). Esperienza di leadership e sviluppo del business in ambienti multiculturali. Solide capacità di problem solving e analisi. Conoscenza degli standard di settore (IEC-62243, NIST CS). Certificazioni rilevanti (CISSP, GICSP, ecc.) sono un vantaggio.

descriptionByLocale.de: Als Director führen Sie ein globales Lieferteam und arbeiten als Teil eines Teams von Problemlösern und helfen, komplexe Cybersicherheitsprobleme von Strategie bis hin zur Umsetzung zu lösen. Sie werden helfen, das spannende Wachstum unserer Cyber-Sicherheits-Praxis fortzusetzen, die sich auf die Industrie, Pharma und Industrieprodukte konzentriert. PwC Professional Fähigkeiten und Verantwortlichkeiten für diese Management-Ebene umfassen, sind aber nicht beschränkt auf: Identifizierung von Lücken im Markt und Spot-Möglichkeiten, um Wertvorstellungen zu entwickeln und zu wachsen Cyber-Geschäft. Suchen Sie nach Möglichkeiten, Effizienz und neue Möglichkeiten der Arbeit in mehreren Projekten und Umgebungen zu skaliert. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, große und komplexe Möglichkeiten zu verfolgen und zu bieten, um die Sicherheitsanforderungen unserer Kunden über Transformationsprogramme zu lösen. Dies beinhaltet die Lieferung Supply Chain, OT, IAM, Managed Services Transformation Programme auf globaler Ebene, beraten Kunden, wie Sie Ihre Ziel-Betriebsmodelle definieren, um mit IT-OT Konvergenz umzugehen, und ein Siegerteam aufzubauen, um unser spannendes Wachstum in diesem Raum fortzusetzen. Sie werden eine Umgebung schaffen, in der Menschen und Technologie zusammen gedeihen, um mehr zu erreichen, als sie auseinander gehen könnten. Sie werden fahren und ein Unternehmen für die Entwicklung strategischer Kundenbeziehungen, die helfen, das Beste für unsere Menschen und Interessenvertreter zu liefern Sie haben einen Einfluss und erleichtern die Schaffung langfristiger Beziehungen, die dem Unternehmen und unseren Kunden Wert hinzufügen 10+ jahrelange Erfahrung in der Herstellung, Pharma oder Industrieprodukte. Starke Kommunikation, Beratung und Überzeugungskraft. Fluent auf Englisch; Deutsch oder Französisch ist ein Plus. Expertise bei der Bereitstellung komplexer Sicherheitstransformationsprojekte. Zusammenarbeit mit IT-, Risiko-, Fertigungs- und Sicherheitsteams. Erstellen Sie strategische Beziehungen zu Kunden und Anbietern. Erfahrung mit Cybersicherheitsfunktionen (z.B. OT Security, Supply Chain, Vorfallantwort) und Verordnungen (NIS2, EU CRA). Führungs- und Geschäftsentwicklungserfahrung in multikulturellen Umgebungen. Starke Problemlösung und analytische Fähigkeiten. Kenntnisse der Industriestandards (IEC-62243, NIST CS). Relevante Zertifizierungen (CISSP, GICSP, etc.) vorteilhaft.
descriptionByLocale.fr: En tant que directeur, vous dirigerez une équipe mondiale de livraison et travaillerez dans le cadre d'une équipe de résolveurs de problèmes, aidant à résoudre des problèmes complexes de cybersécurité de la stratégie à l'exécution. Vous aiderez à poursuivre la croissance passionnante de notre pratique de cybersécurité axée sur les industries de la fabrication, de la pharmacie et des produits industriels. PwC Les compétences et les responsabilités professionnelles pour ce niveau de gestion comprennent, sans s'y limiter, les éléments suivants : Identifier les lacunes du marché et repérer les occasions de créer des propositions de valeur pour développer et développer la cyberentreprise. Cherchez des occasions d'accroître l'efficacité et de nouvelles façons de travailler dans plusieurs projets et environnements. Vous aurez la chance de poursuivre et de fournir des opportunités importantes et complexes pour résoudre les défis de sécurité de nos clients via les programmes de transformation.
